measurement.scope: Frozen shared-module inputs and HC host object/import-table disassembly; static call sites, not dynamic invocation counts.
findings: The controlled L0/native experiment supplies the same 1242 zebins to both paths. All module hashes are checked; extracted .text hashes document the common GPU instructions.
Identical GPU instruction bytes do not imply identical execution: packet programming, memory placement/cache state, copies and scheduling remain different.
HC host wrappers compile differently. Static COFF relocations identify call sites; repeated call sites are not request-level call counts.
A .lib linked into the executable is not itself a DLL boundary. Import tables show actual PE DLL dependencies; dynamic LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress can add dependencies.
The runtime copy counters are a separate pending diagnostic, not part of this static audit.
caveats: This audit describes the pinned frozen comparison. It does not claim the current production executable was rebuilt from current source.
L0/Intel driver internals and exact WDDM submissions are not recovered from PE import tables. No cross-library time is inferred from the number of symbols.
The normal-rebuild norm-capture experiment changes some images on both sides and is a separate measurement.
